KUMARAGURU DOCTORAL FELLOWSHIP (KDF)

Kumaraguru Doctoral Fellowship - KDF (Full time & Residential) invites aspirational and meritorious candidates to pursue their research degree in the field of engineering, acquire the requisite skills and deepen the competency in the interdisciplinary research.

Objectives :
  • To promote a sustainable research environment in the thrust areas.
  • To inculcate interdisciplinary research among the Departments, across the KI Institutions.
  • To provide solutions to scientific and technological issues, thereby contributing to the sustainable development of the society.
Intake, Eligibility and Duration :
Eligibility
Mandatory :

Freshers / Candidates with up to 3 years of experience with :

  • Master's degree in Engineering / Technology/ Management
  • Individuals working in Research Areas / Laboratories in Government / Industry are eligible to apply
  • Candidates with MSc Mathematics /Statistics / Physics / Chemistry or Masters in Management Domains are eligible to apply
Desirable :

Preference will be given to GATE qualified candidates

Duration :
  • Fellowship will be awarded for a period of 3 years to complete the research.
  • Continuous reviews and assessments will determine the conclusion of the fellowship.
  • Fellowship will be withdrawn in the event of not attaining the research goals.
Category
Compensation

UG & PG Degree with a minimum CGPA of 6.5

Selection Process :
  • Advertisment for intake of Applicants
  • Online Application Submission
  • Phase 1 - Eligibility Criteria Assessments and Entrance Test
  • Phase 2-Interview & Selection Process as per required competency matrix by Selection Committee
  • Communication to candidates with Admission details
  • Induction program/ Training for Faculty Supervisors
  • Application to AU and Selection for phD Program
  • Admissions for the Academic Year 2023 (June intake)
  • Course Registration and Research Activities
Learnings & Outcome Expected :

2 Scopus Publications
Preparation of Research Proposal for Extramural Funding / Presenting Research Case to the relevant Industries for financial assistance Take care of Laboratories during Evening Hours
2nd Year Complete Oral Comprehensive assessment in the research area
Take care of Laboratories related to Research Area
Co-guide PG / UG Capstone Projects
2 Science Citation Indexed Publications
To learn, develop and facilitate one software tool or experimental setup in the institution
3rd year 1 Patent – Published and license granted
Co-guide PG / UG Capstone Projects
1 SCI publication and 1 Scopus Publication
Submission of Synopsis and Thesis to University
